findings.description: The Total box is pulled up by a negative top margin (-46px) and overlaps/covers the last expense row (Project dinner, $93.25), so that row is hidden on desktop and cut off on phones. Happens for viewer and editor, at 1280px and 360px, and with a filter applied.
repro: Observe the last row (Project dinner) is covered by the Total box

findings.description: Keyboard focus indicator is removed globally (outline: none on *:focus and *:focus-visible, with no replacement style), so keyboard users cannot see which link, button or field has focus.
repro: No visible focus ring on links, buttons or select

notes: Total arithmetic and viewer permissions (403 on new/edit/post/delete) were correct. Did not submit add/edit/delete.
